what_worked_well: Multi-agent concurrent implementation dramatically accelerated development
Using Task tool with 5 specialized agents completed Phase 1 in parallel
TDD approach with high coverage targets (95%+) ensured quality
Clear separation of concerns between components enabled independent development
Comprehensive testing from start prevented integration issues
Documentation created alongside implementation ensured knowledge capture
challenges_encountered: Initial test suite run took longer than expected due to large number of tests
psycopg2 dependency warning appearing in CLI (not critical, but should be handled)
Need to ensure all Phase 1 components are properly exposed in __init__.py files
optimizations_applied: Incremental processing uses efficient SQL filtering vs full table scans
Quality framework supports batch validation for performance
Hot-reload includes debouncing to prevent excessive reloads
State management uses SHA256 hashing for efficient change detection
Logging includes automatic rotation to prevent disk bloat
future_improvements: Add CLI command for quality checking (sbdk quality check)
Create example projects demonstrating each Phase 1 feature
Add more documentation on incremental strategies comparison
Consider adding telemetry for Phase 1 feature usage
Expand testing framework with more domain-specific assertions

architecture_decisions.impact: StateManager can be used by other components needing persistence

architecture_decisions.rationale: Non-technical users can define rules, version control friendly
architecture_decisions.impact: Enables data analysts to create quality rules without Python knowledge

architecture_decisions.decision: Custom pytest assertions vs standard assertions
architecture_decisions.rationale: Better error messages, domain-specific validation, reusability
architecture_decisions.impact: Test failures are much clearer and actionable

architecture_decisions.rationale: Prevents excessive reloads when saving multiple files
architecture_decisions.impact: Smoother development experience, reduced CPU usage

architecture_decisions.rationale: Enables programmatic error handling, better monitoring
architecture_decisions.impact: Downstream tools can react to specific error types
